items.title: Instant machine chooser
items.text: The "New Remote Window" machine list now appears instantly at launch, seeded from a local cache of your known machines. Rows show a "checking…" state while a quiet background refresh confirms which machines are actually reachable — no more staring at an empty list while it loads.

items.title: No more hangs closing remote windows
items.text: Closing a remote window (or quitting with remote windows open) can no longer freeze the app while it tears down the connection.

items.title: Smarter reconnect behavior
items.text: If a remote session is in a broken state, Ghoztty now stops retrying instead of looping through futile reconnect attempts.

items.title: Sign in and out from the tray
items.text: The agent's tray menu now shows your signed-in account email and lets you sign in or out directly, with a refreshed icon and menu layout.

items.title: Working "Check for updates"
items.text: The tray's update check now actually checks for and applies updates on demand.

items.title: Security hardening
items.text: The agent no longer accepts unauthenticated local connections, and its credentials file on Windows is locked down to your user account only.
